summary: Keep the shared local archive intact across servers: refuse --no-prune=false on sync --full, and when a different server syncs or archives into a database whose checkpoints another server wrote, reset every checkpoint atomically under a run-level file lock.
reason: sync_state checkpoints are keyed by resource only and pruning compares the whole table with one server's listing, while this CLI syncs several servers into one archive. Without the guards a second server resumes the first server's cursor and skips older messages, a partial-resource sync leaves the other server's checkpoints behind, and a prune deletes other servers' rows and expired messages.
validated_outcome: TestClaimPostmarkSyncScopeResetsOtherServersCheckpoints (all checkpoints reset on a switch, kept for the same server, row counts untouched), TestSyncFromAnotherServerWalksEverything (A, then B resets, then B resumes), and TestKeepPostmarkArchiveOnFullSync pass. TestPostmarkSyncLockWaitEndsWithContext: a held lock makes a second acquire fail once its deadline passes, and the lock is free again after release.
